title: When Should a Human Take Back Control? Optimal Delegation under Turbulent AI Risk
abstract: arXiv:2609.32083v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When should a human take control from an autonomous AI agent, how much checking is worthwhile, and when should autonomy resume? These decisions become harder when incidents cluster and recent errors signal elevated risk. Exploratory analyses of AgentLogs coding-agent traces and ODCV-Bench task runs show higher held-out log likelihood for Hawkes incident-history models than matched no-history baselines, with positive gains whose conditional $90\%$ intervals exclude zero. AgentLogs evaluates continuous-time incident timing and type; ODCV evaluates failure occurrence at discrete decisions. Motivated by this predictive evidence, we formulate a continuous-time delegation problem that jointly chooses productive action, verification effort, and switching rates between human-directed, AI-assisted operation and autonomous AI operation. translated_title: 人类何时应该收回控制权？动荡AI风险下的最优委托
translated_abstract: 人类何时应该从自主AI智能体手中接管控制权？多少检查是值得的？何时应该恢复自主运行？当事故呈现聚集发生、且近期错误预示风险升高时，这些决策变得更加困难。对AgentLogs编码智能体日志和ODCV-Bench任务运行记录的探索性分析表明，Hawkes事故历史模型相比匹配的无历史基线具有更高的留出对数似然，其正增益的条件90%区间不包含零。AgentLogs评估连续时间下事故的发生时序与类型，而ODCV则评估离散决策点的故障发生。受这一预测证据启发，我们构建了一个连续时间委托问题，联合选择生产性动作、验证工作量，以及在人工主导的AI辅助运行与自主AI运行之间的切换速率。该模型假设验证能够削弱事故传播，并在项目收益与……之间取得平衡。
tldr: 该论文基于Hawkes事故历史模型对AI事故聚集风险的有效预测，提出了一个连续时间委托问题，联合优化生产性动作、验证工作量以及人机控制权切换速率，从而为人类在动荡AI风险环境下何时收回控制权提供最优策略。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates a continuous-time delegation problem that jointly optimizes productive action, verification effort, and switching rates between human-directed and autonomous AI operation, leveraging Hawkes incident-history models that predict clustering AI risk to determine when a human should take back control.
